name: 𝗔𝗔𝗦𝗛𝗜𝗙-𝗠𝗗
description: Atassa, a Multi Device Whatsapp Bot built by Gifted Tech to Enhance Whatsapp Communication Experience

SESSION_ID.description: WhatsApp bot SESSION_ID. Optional at deploy time; can be set/changed from Telegram after /password auth.

MODE.description: Worktype of your bot. Use 'public' (everyone can use it) or 'private' (only bot number).

TIME_ZONE.description: Your timezone e.g. Africa/Nairobi, America/New_York, Asia/Kolkata

AUTO_LIKE_STATUS.description: Auto-like WhatsApp statuses. Set true or false.

AUTO_READ_STATUS.description: Auto-view WhatsApp statuses. Set true or false.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Leave blank to use the auto-provisioned Heroku Postgres addon, or supply your own (Neon, Supabase, etc.). Falls back to SQLite if empty and no addon is attached.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Used for session setup flow.

TELEGRAM_PASSWORD.description: Password required in Telegram (/password <value>) before accepting SESSION_ID.

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Heroku API key (optional). If set, Telegram session updates also write to Heroku config var SESSION_ID.

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Heroku app name (optional) used with HEROKU_API_KEY for remote SESSION_ID updates.
